recipes.name: Mega Beef Bowl inspired by Persona 4
ingredients: 2 rice cookers' worth of short grain rice
instructions: For the Dashi
Begin by decapitating your Niboshi. Remove the heads to avoid bitter flavors.
In a medium container, combine headless Niboshi and 1 qt of water. Set aside, allowing the fish to soak for 20-30 minutes. - water

While the Niboshi are soaking, in a stock pot, combine Bonito Flakes, dried Shiitake mushrooms, and Kombu with several quarts of water. - 10 g dried Bonito Flakes - 3 dried Shiitake mushrooms - 5 pieces of Kombu - water
Transfer the Niboshi and its broth to the stock pot and bring to a boil. Simmer for a few minutes to let the flavors infuse.
Strain the broth using a mesh sieve and set aside.
For the Rice
Measure short grain white rice according to your rice cooker and rinse under cold water until it runs clear to remove excess starch. - 2 rice cookers' worth of short grain rice
Add the rinsed rice to your rice cooker and fill with water until it reaches the first knuckle of your index finger when touching the rice (an old Asian cooking trick). - water
Close the lid, hit the cook button, and let the rice cook. Make 2 batches.
For the Sauce
Slice onions into rounds. Not too thin in favor of adding texture to the dish. Set aside. - 2 large yellow onions thinly sliced
Slice ribeye into manageable sections. Avoid cutting them too small. You want the meat to stay tender, not fall apart. - 6 lbs ribeye thinly sliced
In a large pan, combine Dashi, Mirin, soy sauce, and granulated sugar. - For the Dashi - 1 cup Mirin - 1 cup soy sauce - 20 g granulated sugar
Bring the sauce to a boil and simmer.
While the sauce simmers, add onions in batches first (they take longer to tenderize), and then add the beef in small portions. - 2 large yellow onions thinly sliced - 6 lbs ribeye thinly sliced
Cook until the beef is no longer pink, stirring constantly to keep it from sticking together.
Using tongs, transfer the beef and onions to a separate bowl, leaving the sauce behind to cook the next round of beef and onions.
Repeat until all the beef and onions are cooked, about 30 minutes. Using a cheesecloth, strain cloudy sauce to remove unwanted sediment.
For the Assembly
Heat a small pan with butter, crack your egg, and fry until you have a perfectly smooth, sunny-side-up egg. - 1 tbsp butter - 1 large egg
If you want it picture-perfect, carefully trim the edges for that 'anime' look.
In a serving bowl (mega bowl!) big enough to fit all of the rice, beef, and onions, add all of the freshly cooked rice to the bowl (about 2 rice cookers' worth). - For the Rice
Pile on every ounce of tender beef and onions. - 6 lbs ribeye thinly sliced - 2 large yellow onions thinly sliced
Finally, top it all off with the sunny-side-up egg as your crown jewel. - 1 large egg
Ladle the sweet, savory sauce back over the beef and rice to bring everything together. - For the Sauce
Serve hot.
